jobs.title: Senior Consultant Cardiologist
jobs.description: Deva Hospital is seeking a board-certified Senior Consultant Cardiologist to lead our cardiac catheterization laboratory and clinical diagnostic cardiology team. The role entails providing high-level specialized cardiology consultations, performing complex coronary interventions, participating in multi-disciplinary heart team reviews, and mentoring post-graduate medical residents.
jobs.requirements:
• MD or equivalent medical degree with specialization in Cardiology.
• Board certification or valid specialist registration.
• Minimum of 7 years of post-specialist clinical cardiology experience.
• Proven expertise in echocardiography, angiography, and coronary interventions.
• Active medical license in good standing.

jobs.title: Charge Nurse — Intensive Care Unit (ICU)
jobs.description: We are recruiting experienced Charge Nurses to oversee 24/7 nursing operations across our 28-bed state-of-the-art Intensive Care Unit. Responsibilities include clinical patient care oversight, rapid response coordination, nursing staff scheduling, and adherence to strict international critical care protocols.
jobs.requirements:
• Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) or equivalent from an accredited institution.
• Valid RN license with Critical Care Registered Nurse (CCRN) certification preferred.
• Minimum of 4 years of acute ICU or trauma critical care nursing experience.
• Valid ACLS, BLS, and PALS certifications.
• Strong leadership and crisis management competencies.

jobs.title: Senior Medical Laboratory Technologist
jobs.description: Responsible for conducting complex hematological, microbiological, histological, and biochemical diagnostic assays using automated clinical analyzers and molecular diagnostics systems. Ensures rigorous quality control and fast turnaround times for emergency and surgical units.
jobs.requirements:
• Bachelor of Medical Laboratory Science (BMLS) or equivalent.
• Professional registration with relevant Medical Laboratory Council.
• Minimum 3 years clinical diagnostic experience in hematology/microbiology.
• Familiarity with automated analyzers (Roche, Abbott) and LIMS software.

jobs.title: Clinical Pharmacist Specialist
jobs.description: Provide direct patient pharmaceutical care, review inpatient medication orders, perform therapeutic drug monitoring, calculate chemotherapy regimens, and consult with medical teams on antimicrobial stewardship and clinical pharmacology.
jobs.requirements:
• Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD) or B.Pharm with clinical specialization.
• Registered Pharmacist license in good standing.
• Minimum 2 years of hospital pharmacy or clinical oncology pharmacy experience.
• Strong knowledge of pharmacokinetics and sterile compounding protocols.

jobs.title: Emergency Medicine Registrar
jobs.description: Join our busy 24-hour Emergency Department. Triage acute medical and surgical emergencies, conduct resuscitation, stabilize critically injured patients, and collaborate with trauma surgeons and critical care teams.
jobs.requirements:
• MBBS / MBChB or equivalent medical degree.
• Completion of internship and at least 2 years in emergency or acute care medicine.
• Current ATLS, ACLS, and BLS certification.
• Excellent diagnostic acumen and calm demeanor under intense emergency pressures.

jobs.title: Senior Radiographer / MRI Specialist
jobs.description: Operate 3.0T MRI, 128-slice CT scanners, and digital fluoroscopy equipment. Ensure high-resolution diagnostic imaging while prioritizing radiation safety and patient comfort.
jobs.requirements:
• Bachelor of Science in Radiography or Medical Imaging.
• Valid professional licensing.
• Minimum 3 years specialized MRI/CT clinical experience.
• Proficiency in PACS and RIS software systems.

jobs.title: Hospital Operations & Admissions Coordinator
jobs.description: Coordinate inpatient admissions, liaise with medical insurance providers, oversee patient registration workflows, and ensure outstanding patient advocacy and healthcare compliance.
jobs.requirements:
• Bachelor degree in Healthcare Administration, Business, or Public Health.
• 2+ years of experience in hospital front-office or healthcare operations.
• Proficient in Electronic Health Records (EHR/HIS) and insurance billing.
• Exceptional multilingual communication skills.

jobs.title: Pediatric Specialist Resident
jobs.description: Provide compassionate, evidence-based care in general pediatrics, pediatric emergency, and neonatal intensive care unit (NICU). Participate in pediatric code teams and clinical audit meetings.
jobs.requirements:
• MD / MBBS with completed pediatric residency credits.
• Neonatal Resuscitation Program (NRP) and PALS certified.
• Passion for pediatric inpatient and ambulatory healthcare.
• Strong family-centered communication skills.
